How to review
  • Check the wording, visual hierarchy and role descriptions for your team's audit process.
  • Compare light and dark views. The original app content uses 200% text scaling; browser zoom changes this gallery separately.
  • Use Tab to reach controls and Enter to enlarge an image. Escape closes the image viewer.
  • Record acceptance separately after the authenticated native walkthrough and screen-reader checks.

Images show the captured viewport. Offscreen content and interactive states require the native acceptance checklist.
